basic_details.scholarship_name: Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) School of Computer Science Graduate Assistantship
basic_details.offering_entity: Carnegie Mellon University (School of Computer Science - SCS)
basic_details.major_restrictions: School of Computer Science departments: Computer Science Department (CSD), Machine Learning Department (MLD), Language Technologies Institute (LTI), Robotics Institute (RI), Human-Computer Interaction Institute (HCII), Software and Societal Systems Department (S3D), Computational Biology Department (CBD).
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~120 to 150 new doctoral research assistants admitted each year across SCS departments
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: Open global merit competition; all admitted PhD students receive full tuition and stipend guarantee (typically 1 to 4 Pakistani scholars admitted/yr)
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: Full duration of doctoral studies (typically 5 to 6 years, contingent on satisfactory research progress)

nationality_requirements: Open to international students from all nationalities holding F-1 or J-1 student visas
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed undergraduate degree (Bachelor's, 16 years education) or Master's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or related STEM discipline.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: Minimum 3.80+ / 4.00 CGPA; competitive admitted candidates typically possess near-perfect GPA or top 1-2% class standing.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Advanced algorithms, discrete mathematics, computer systems, probability, and linear algebra.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Graduated or currently in final semester of undergraduate/master's studies.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Exceptional research accomplishments (publications at NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ACL, SIGCOMM, OSDI) and open-source contributions heavily prioritized.

english_proficiency.notes: TOEFL iBT min 100 (subscores 25+), IELTS Academic min 7.5 (subscores 7.0+), or Duolingo English Test (DET) min 125.

eligibility_requirements.gender_specific_requirements: Equal opportunity; women in computing actively encouraged.
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Elite computer science and artificial intelligence research candidates.

tuition_fee.details: 100% full tuition waiver provided through departmental Graduate Research Assistantship (GRA) or Teaching Assistantship (GTA).

admission_application_fee.details: CMU SCS application fee ($100 per program, up to $150 for multi-program application); fee waivers available for demonstrated financial hardship.

accommodation.details: Paid out of generous monthly research stipend; off-campus apartments in Pittsburgh (Squirrel Hill, Shadyside, Oakland) ~$800–1,200/mo.

monthly_stipend.details: Graduate Research Assistantship living stipend of ~$3,200 to $3,500/month (~USD $38,400 to $42,000/year / ~PKR 890,000 to 975,000/month).

airfare.details: Travel costs borne by student; select research labs provide relocation allowances.

visa_fee.details: US F-1 Visa application fee ($185) and SEVIS I-901 fee ($350) paid by applicant.

health_insurance.details: CMU Student Health Insurance Plan (SHIP) 100% covered for PhD students.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: High-end research workstations, departmental GPU compute clusters, and cloud credits (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure) provided free.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Full travel, accommodation, and registration costs paid by lab for any accepted conference papers.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Pittsburgh Regional Transit (PRT) universal bus and light rail pass included on CMU ID card.

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single institution: Carnegie Mellon University (Pittsburgh, PA, USA).
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: #1 globally in Computer Science (US News), #1 in Artificial Intelligence, #1 in Programming Languages, #1 in Software Engineering.
available_majors: Computer Science, Machine Learning, Language Technologies (NLP), Robotics, Human-Computer Interaction, Software Engineering, Computational Biology, Societal Computing
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Bachelor's or Master's in CS/Math/Engineering with outstanding academic transcript, top research publications, and stellar recommendation letters.
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: CMU SCS PhD is tied with MIT and Stanford as the most selective computer science program in the world.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: CMU SCS allows applying to up to 3 PhD programs with one application fee. Carefully designate primary faculty advisors in the application essay.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Carnegie Mellon University SCS Graduate Application System
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Create an applicant account on the CMU SCS online admissions portal during the Fall application window.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Review faculty research profiles across SCS departments (September-October).
2. Create account on CMU SCS graduate application portal.
3. Select target PhD program(s) (e.g. CSD, MLD, LTI, RI).
4. Upload Statement of Purpose, CV, transcripts, and publication PDFs.
5. Nominate 3 academic/research referees who submit confidential letters.
6. Pay application fee before early December deadline.
7. Faculty review dossiers and conduct video interviews (January-February).
8. Receive admission decision in February; attend CMU SCS Open House.
9. Accept offer by April 15 (national graduate resolution deadline).
10. Receive I-20 and apply for US F-1 student visa.
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Integrated single application: all admitted PhD students automatically receive full funding.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Submitted online by 3 referees through CMU confidential referee system.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: Statement of Purpose (1-2 pages) describing research interests, prior projects, publications, and specific CMU faculty alignment.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Academic CV detailing publications, conference presentations, GitHub repositories, and competitive programming achievements.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Prospective faculty advisors conduct 30-60 minute video interviews on technical depth, mathematics, and research methodology.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: GRE General test is optional for most SCS programs.
application_process_roadmap.application_fee_amount: USD $100 per program ($150 for multi-program submission).
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: Unofficial transcripts uploaded during application; official verified transcripts required upon matriculation.

required_documents_checklist.specification: Scanned copy of valid international passport
Transcripts for all completed university-level degrees
Confidential research appraisals from research mentors or internationally recognized scientists
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: From undergraduate thesis advisors or international collaborators

required_documents_checklist.specification: Structured essay (1-2 pages) articulating technical vision, research track record, and prospective CMU faculty match
required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Focus on domain depth and specific CMU labs

required_documents_checklist.specification: Official language score report meeting CMU SCS cutoffs

important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Single annual intake; December 10 deadline is strictly observed.

selection_process_and_weights.work_experience_weight: 5% (Industry research lab internships e.g. Google DeepMind, Microsoft Research)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: SCS Department Admissions Committee comprising tenured and tenure-track faculty.
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Faculty individual review -> Departmental admissions meeting ranking -> Formal offer with guaranteed multi-year funding package.

competitiveness_profile.total_annual_applicants: ~6,000 international and domestic applicants to SCS doctoral programs
competitiveness_profile.total_scholarships_awarded: ~130 to 150 fully funded PhD offers across all departments
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Graduates from elite institutions (NUST, FAST, LUMS, GIKI) with top class standing, top-tier conference publications (NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ACL), and strong mathematical maturity.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Pakistani alumni of CMU SCS have gone on to lead AI labs at major tech firms or tenure-track professorships.
competitiveness_profile.high_representation_countries: United States, China, India, South Korea, Canada, Pakistan, Iran, Germany.

fake_websites_and_scams: Unauthorized consultancy domains claiming direct CMU admission: cmu-scs-fellowships.org, carnegie-visa-portal.com.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Application fee ($100) is paid only inside official CMU SCS portal. Fee waivers are available for eligible candidates who request them early.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: CMU SCS never uses commercial agents or recruitment firms.
itemized_hidden_out_of_pocket_costs: US F-1 Visa application fee and SEVIS I-901 fee (USD $535 / ~PKR 150,000)
Initial apartment security deposit and first month's rent in Pittsburgh (~USD $1,800 to $2,500)
debunked_myths_and_misconceptions: MYTH: You need a Master's degree to apply for CMU CS PhD. (Truth: Direct-entry Bachelor's degree holders are welcomed and make up roughly half of incoming classes).
MYTH: You must secure your own research funding. (Truth: All admitted PhD students receive full multi-year tuition and stipend guarantees directly from the school).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites claim GRE is mandatory; CMU SCS made GRE optional for most PhD programs.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Maintain minimum 3.00 GPA in graduate coursework and make satisfactory progress in doctoral research milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Full-time physical research residence at CMU Pittsburgh campus.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Semi-annual 'Black Friday' faculty review meetings where all PhD students are evaluated individually.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Teaching Assistantship duties (typically 2 semesters during PhD) required as part of academic training; outside employment prohibited without advisor approval.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: None; international PhD graduates qualify for 3-year US STEM OPT extension and EB-2 National Interest Waiver (NIW) green card pathways.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Funding discontinued if student fails qualifier exams or is dismissed from program for lack of progress.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing departments within SCS requires approval from both departments.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Funding is continued through year 5 and year 6 provided student makes continuous progress toward dissertation defense.
